title: Hallucination as a Feature, not a Defect: Evaluating a multi-agent architecture to transform speculative language-model outputs into testable scientific hypotheses
abstract: arXiv:2608.19206v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly aligned to suppress hallucinations, prioritizing factual retrieval over combinatorial creativity. While crucial for mitigating misinformation, this alignment may also restrict speculative Research and Development (R&D) by encouraging what this work operationally treats as semantic overfitting and diversity collapse. In this paper, we propose a Rust-based multi-agent orchestration that uses the contrast between narrative daydreaming and executive control as a functional analogy, not as a neurocognitive claim. The system instigates an Epistemological Friction loop between a high-entropy generating agent and a web-grounded evaluating agent, mediated by a low-entropy semantic bottleneck intended to reduce noise and repetition. translated_title: 幻觉作为特征而非缺陷：评估一种多智能体架构将推测性语言模型输出转化为可检验的科学假设
translated_abstract: 当代大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越倾向于抑制幻觉，优先考虑事实检索而非组合创造力。虽然这对减少错误信息至关重要，但这种对齐也可能限制推测性研发（R&D），因为本工作操作性地将其视为语义过拟合和多样性崩溃。在本文中，我们提出一种基于Rust的多智能体编排，利用叙事性白日梦与执行控制之间的对比作为功能类比，而非神经认知主张。该系统在一种高熵生成智能体与一种基于网络的评估智能体之间引发“认识论摩擦”循环，并由一个低熵语义瓶颈介导，旨在减少噪声和重复。初步实验在物理和社会科学领域生成了多样化的、具有可行性评级的假设。我们另外报告了一项探索性的配对分析。
tldr: 本文提出一种利用幻觉作为特征的多智能体架构，通过高熵生成与低熵评估的对抗循环，将推测性语言模型输出转化为可检验的科学假设，并初步验证其跨领域生成多样性和可行性的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agent architecture that leverages hallucination as a feature, using an adversarial loop between high-entropy generation and low-entropy evaluation to transform speculative LLM outputs into testable scientific hypotheses, with initial experiments demonstrating cross-domain diversity and viability.
